text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... "School of the Dead 2" was intense, 
wasn't it?! My heart is still racing...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If something like that chased me, I'd... 
eeeeek~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Don't worry, Craft. There's no need 
to be scared.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I mean, do you really think that thing can 
keep up with us? —Not a chance. It won't 
even graze our tails!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh, right! You're totally right! 
...Yeah! Thinking about it that way... 
*phew*.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You're so dependable, Heart-san! 
The movie wasn't scary at all for you, was 
it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Saying 'not at all' would be a lie, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, isn't that impossible?! Just 
thinking about it gives me chills! 
Something like that—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ghosts throwing a party at the pool of all 
places?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, um, wasn't that part... y'know, 
supposed to be a gag scene...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Calling that terror a 'gag'! I'd 
certainly love to learn from that strong 
heart of yours."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? That's how it turns out!? Uh, 
which one is... huhhh~...?
